title: Look up units before writing a parameter
goal: Convert a musical value (300 ms release, -6 dB) into the engine value Falcon stores, before any write.

steps.why: The panel shows ms; the engine stores seconds. Writing 300 would mean 300 seconds (clamped to 10).
Let the server do the conversion and keep its steps as evidence.
Gains are linear factors in the engine, not dB.

conclusion: Write ReleaseTime=0.3 and Gain=0.501. After writing, read the value back and render: a correct number is not yet an audible result.
